{{Dialogue|Graying Rebel|Enough, Merak. We share your pain, and your mourning for your lost home.|Ketrian Altronel|You're Alderaanian?|Merak|One of the few.|attr=A Rebel, Ketrian Altronel, and Merak|src=<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>}}
'''Merak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Merak was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was part of an Alliance team [[First mission to Hargeeva|sent]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] in an attempt to recruit the [[metallurgist]] [[Ketrian Altronel]] to the Alliance cause.<ref name="Firepower" />
